final_answer: Learning rate in machine learning refers to the rate at which a machine learning model can adapt and improve its performance on a given task. It controls the extent of change in the model's parameters during training and significantly impacts the model's ability to learn from data. Documents 2 and 5 elaborate on this definition, stating that machine learning is the study of programs that can learn and improve automatically.
